snippet.title: Konağın Yeni Hanımı "Zeynep Altay"! - Anne Yarısı 8. Bölüm (İLK SAHNE)
snippet.description:
Zeynep, evlilik cüzdanını görünce şok oldu. ARTIK MERYEM ALTAY’IN GELİNİSİN!
Anne Yarısı 8. Bölümü izlemek için tıklayın: https://youtu.be/fd76r3TnXwk

(17 Kasım 2026)

Ali, Zeynep’in haberi olmadan onunla evlenme işini halletmiş, böylece hem kızından koparılmamış hem de annesinin hapishaneye girme ihtimalini ortadan kaldırmıştır. Durumu öğrenen Zeynep çok sinirlenir ve nikahı iptal ettirmek üzere harekete geçer. Ancak Ali onun da önlemini almıştır. Zeynep’i iki gün zorla bir bağ evinde tutarak iptalin önünü alır. Zeynep ve Ali’nin evliliğini konaktakilere açıklama görevi ise Meryem’e düşer. Duruma en çok sevinen ise Ege olacaktır. Bu haberi Ege’den öğrenen Bayındır ailesinde ise tam bir şok yaşanır. Altın kendi oğlu kurtuldu diye sevinirken Kadir karaları bağlar. Sibel’in şantajından kurtulmak için karısının altınlarını çalıp ona veren Asım’ın başı belaya girer. Sibel hırsızlıkla suçlanınca gerçekleri söyler, böylece Asım ve Songül konaktan kovulurlar. Nazlı ve Özcan ilişkisi Altın yüzünden zor günler geçiriyordur. Nazlı, Altın’dan kurtulmak için büyük bir hamle yapar. İki gün baş başa kalmak Zeynep ve Ali’yi iyice birbirlerine yaklaştıracaktır.

Sekiz yıl önce yaşanan büyük bir kaybın ardından yolları aynı çocuğun etrafında kesişen Ali ve Zeynep’in duygu yüklü hikayesini ekrana taşıyacak. Geçmişin sırları, velayet mücadelesi ve büyük fedakarlıklarla örülen dizi, izleyiciyi etkileyici bir yolculuğa çıkaracak.

المنتخب الجزائري 

ملخص وأهداف مباراة الجزائر وتوغو اليوم الثلاثاء 17-11-2026 بتعليق المعلق الجزائري حفيظ دراجي، في المواجهة القوية التي جمعت المنتخبين على أرضية ملعب كيغيه في العاصمة التوغولية لومي. شاهد أبرز اللقطات، الفرص الضائعة، وأهداف لقاء الإياب بين محاربي الصحراء ومنتخب توغو.

تشكيلة المنتخب الجزائري في المباراة:
• حراسة المرمى: ميلفين ماستيل.
• خط الدفاع: رامي بن سبعيني، أحمد توبة، سعدي رضواني، أشرف عبادة.
• خط الوسط: نبيل بن طالب، ياسين تيطراوي، حيماد عبدلي.
• خط الهجوم: عبد الرحمن رباش، فارس غجميس، منصف بقرار.

تشكيلة منتخب توغو في المباراة:
• حراسة المرمى: ستيفن فودو منساه.
• خط الدفاع: لويك بيسيلي، كيفن بوما، كينيدي بواتينغ، ساديق فوفانا.
• خط الوسط: روجر أهولو، ألايكسيس روماو، ديرمان كريم.
• خط الهجوم: كيفين دينكي، إيهلاس بيبو، ياو أنور.

snippet.title: Directing Homeland Security Sec during nationwide outages
snippet.description:
Directing Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin as system outages continue across the U.S.

From grounded flights to frozen bank accounts, why does it seem like everything is breaking at once? 

First, millions of people lost access to their email. Next, the nation's skies went quiet. Then, a wave of customers trying to send money through Zelle were met with error messages.
In just five days, a rapid succession of high-profile technology failures has left consumers rattled. The Federal Aviation Administration was forced into a rare nationwide ground stop. Microsoft’s ubiquitous office software went dark. Now a software bug has hit banking, and United Airlines had a fleeting system outage that delayed flight departures.

Modern technological systems are so complex and tightly interwoven that a single error can snowball instantly, wiping out essential services, according to Mike Chapple, a professor at the University of Notre Dame.

The FAA outage, for example, was triggered by either a faulty component or an installation error by a government contractor during a modernization project. That single mistake flooded the air traffic control network with data, crippling nationwide infrastructure, Chapple said.

Meanwhile, the Microsoft outage was caused by a dormant software bug that had lingered undetected since July. Last week, "conditions were just right to activate the bug, triggering a cascade of failures that knocked thousands of systems offline and hindered repair efforts," he said.

While the exact cause of the banking disruptions remains unclear, Chapple speculated it is likely a technical issue in shared payment networks. Chase said it experienced a temporary issue related to a software bug.

Caption from article by Jessica Guynn, USA Today.

Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who abruptly stepped down last week after a scandal involving extramarital affairs, said Tuesday he would be “honored” to return to the role if the board were to allow it.

snippet.title: Mumbai Indians' auction targets for IPL 2027 🎯 Boult back?
snippet.description:
Mumbai have Bumrah, and now Arshdeep too. But the bowlers who took 14 of their 23 powerplay wickets in IPL 2026 have left.
9 slots, only 2 overseas, ₹32.6 crore 💰

Our 4 targets 🎯
1️⃣ Trent Boult: a cheaper return. He played for MI New York, MI Cape Town and MI London in the past year
2️⃣ Deepak Chahar: 72 IPL powerplay wickets
3️⃣ Kumar Kartikeya: 18 wickets in the MP League 2026
4️⃣ Abishek Porel: an Indian keeper, because de Kock and Rickelton are both overseas

Who should Mumbai buy first? 👇
🗓️ Auction: 16 December, Goa

▶ Full video, all 10 teams: https://youtu.be/ZzyAPuSpOq8
